title: Mega desk
intro: Two people, about 40 minutes. Build it where it will stand: the finished desk does not fit through a door. Legs and rails are 3030 extrusion; every joint is a corner bracket with T-nuts, so leave all screws finger-tight until the top is on, then square it up and tighten.

legs.note: The two longer legs go at the BACK (they reach the back rail, which sits above the top). Foot rails join a front leg to its back leg; the slot faces inward.

frame.note: Front long rail flush with the top of the front legs; back long rail one MDF thickness higher. Cross rails sit on the front rail at the leg lines and the centre. A corner bracket goes inside each leg under the long rail: one screw up into the rail, one into the leg (the screws and T-nuts are in the model, so the list above counts them).

top.note: Drop the MDF on from above: it sits inside the back rail and over the front one. Centre it left-right, then tighten every bracket.
fasteners: 6 × 4.5×30 wood screws through the cross rails

uprights.note: Uprights stand on the back rail at the three marks; plumb them against the wall before tightening. Pegboards hang on the uprights' front slots with the printed hooks.

shelf.note: Hook the three shelf brackets into the uprights at the same height (count slots from the top), then lay the board on. The bins just sit on the board.

ceiling.note: Nothing to do: the ceiling is shown so the shelf height makes sense. The flat part clears the uprights by 20 mm.
